purpose: Point-in-time technical due diligence for a commercially cautious Türkiye reference corpus. A source decision does not replace asset-level provenance review or legal advice.
legal_disclaimer: This policy records technical licensing risk, not legal clearance or legal advice. Rights in code, model weights, imagery, metadata, APIs, cached files and derived embeddings are evaluated separately.
default_rules: Absence of an explicit applicable license means no commercial permission.
A code license does not grant rights in model weights, training data, imagery or API content.
Display or API access rights do not imply persistent caching, embedding or indexing rights; each permission is evaluated independently.
Every acquired asset must carry a provenance receipt, applicable license snapshot and deletion state.
Share-alike sources must remain source-partitioned until counsel confirms the scope of reciprocal obligations.
A revocation or valid removal request must be traceable from source asset to every normalized derivative, descriptor, index shard, backup and report.
Component rights never inherit: code, released weights, training corpora, input imagery, cached objects, descriptors and indexes each require an applicable grant.

released_weights.artifact_license: MIT as declared by the author-maintained model card
released_weights.scope: Pinned released weight artifact only; no training-corpus or input-imagery rights inherit

training_corpora.scope: Five independently governed training corpora identified by the paper; rights are not granted by either MIT declaration

future_atlaslens_inputs.scope: Each reference image, cache, descriptor and index shard follows its own source-policy record and asset manifest; MegaLoc grants no rights over them

sample4geo.non_inheritance_rule: The Sample4Geo repository, linked weights, and each of CVUSA, CVACT, VIGOR and University-1652 are separate assets; no component promotes another.

plonk.non_inheritance_rule: MIT code/model-card declarations do not grant training-media, new input-imagery, cache, descriptor or index rights.
